findings.title: Relocating the active workspace re-lists the Library before the new folder's provider is detected, and the list is not refreshed afterwards
findings.body:
For the active workspace, `relocateWorkspace` runs `relocateActive` (`relocate.ts:46-48`). Its `afterCommit` (`index.ts:524-530`) calls `host?.broadcastLibraryChanged()` inside the transaction, before line 755 detects the new folder. Until then, `syncStates.of` sees a path that changed since the last detection and falls back to the path rule (`sync-state.ts:26-30`). The path rule misses a Drive folder that only the xattr identifies, which is the case `detectSync` exists for (`synced-folder.ts:83-91`). So the windows re-list with `currentVault()` built with no eviction probe (`library/index.ts:71-74`). Evicted items get thumbnail URLs and no "In the cloud" state, and the `kaipu-media://` gate (`media-protocol.ts:126`) is off for requests made in that gap. Those requests open the files, which downloads them.

Once `refresh` finishes, only `broadcastState()` runs (line 759). The Library is never told to re-list, so those cards stay wrong until some unrelated library change. The PR's renderer-side move and drag guards read that list.

Fix: call `host?.broadcastLibraryChanged()` after line 755 when the relocated workspace is the active one. Alternatively, detect the chosen folder before the transaction commits.

contracts.action: After "Change folder…" succeeds, re-detect the workspace's sync provider and return its view with availability and sync
contracts.equivalent_path: createWorkspace (index.ts:628-647) and addWorkspace (index.ts:578) call syncStates.refresh right after the registry write and before any switch or broadcast. initWorkspaces refreshes every entry at launch (index.ts:115).
contracts.before_after: In createWorkspace, refresh runs before runSwitch, so the switch's afterCommit re-list already sees the detected provider. In relocateFolder, the active workspace's transaction (relocateActive, switch-transaction.ts:100-141) commits and fires afterCommit's broadcastLibraryChanged (index.ts:524-530) before refresh at line 755. After the refresh, only broadcastState runs (line 759), with no library re-list.
contracts.visible_effect: The returned workspace view and the broadcast state show the detected provider. The Library listing made during the commit used the path-rule answer (sync-state.ts:26-30). For an xattr-only Drive folder, that listing has no eviction probe (library/index.ts:71-74) and stays that way until the next library change.
contracts.failure_mode: detectSync never throws and bounds each step at the timeout (synced-folder.ts:74-91), so refresh cannot reject. A timed-out step reads as not synced, and the workspace is then treated as a plain folder until the next launch or relocate. availabilityOf is bounded for synced entries (index.ts:176-193).

structuredOutput.summary: This part only touches `relocateFolder`. After a relocation, it now re-detects the folder's sync provider and returns the workspace view with that provider. The return value is right. The problem is the order for the active workspace: the relocate transaction fires `broadcastLibraryChanged` before the detection runs, and nothing re-lists the Library afterwards. A Drive folder that only the xattr identifies is then listed without the eviction probe until some unrelated library change. There are no open threads on this file.
